name: stand-in
description: Evidence-backed synthetic user interviews: personas that answer only from public sources, with a confidence level on every claim.

interface.shortDescription: Interview evidence-backed stand-ins for your users.
interface.longDescription: Researches what a target audience says and does online, builds a panel of personas with different demographics from that evidence, and answers interview questions in character. Every answer cites its sources and a confidence level, and the output is labelled as speculative.
defaultPrompt: Interview some stand-in users about my product idea.
What would my target audience think of this design?
Run a synthetic customer discovery round.
